services.name: Rodanthe Watersports & Campground
services.desc: Escape the hustle and bustle of the daily grind while camping waterfront on Hatteras Island at affordable rates. Rodanthe Watersports & Campground, located on the Pamlico Sound (near the Chicamacomico water tower), is a sure-fire way to achieve a quiet, relaxing Outer Banks vacation and instill the love of the great outdoors in your family. Our scenic setting boasts an array of soundside and soundfront tent, pop-up and RV sites. Electricity and water hook-ups, a bath house with hot showers and WiFi are conveniently provided. Some sites even have firepits! This family-operated campground is within walking distance of the beach, fishing pier, skate park, restaurants and shopping. After

services.name: Surfboard Rentals in Rodanthe, NC
services.desc: Some of the best waves on the East Coast are just across the street from Rodanthe Watersports & Campground. We offer a variety of ways for you to get out and enjoy them. Choose from an array of surfboard, body board and skim board rentals. We have surfboards for all skill levels, from beginner and big boards to mid-range "funboards" or even a high-performance short boards. We offer free surf tips and you can borrow a 'learn to surf' book or video as well. We also offer spring and winter weather wetsuits so you can be comfortable even when the water is cool. services.name: Kayak Rentals in Rodanthe, NC
services.desc: Kayaks set you up for endless fun on both the sound and the ocean! Rodanthe Watersports & Campground has kayak rentals available for your enjoyment. Relax in your kayak as you glide over the warm, shallow waters of the Pamlico Sound, or challenge yourself on the waves of the Atlantic Ocean. Take a front row seat in your kayak for those spectacular Outer Banks sunsets. Our sit-on-top kayaks are fun and easy to use. Launch them from our soundfront site or take them with you to the beach or wherever you choose. We have a few fishing kayaks to choose from as well. Rentals include backrests, life vests and paddles.
